description: This file defines message classes used for server communication in a distributed system, specifically ServerMessage and AckMessage.

classes.name: ServerMessage
classes.description: Represents a server message with message ID, and flags indicating if the message is graceful or a restart request.

classes.name: AckMessage
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message containing a message ID and server name.

methods.name: AckMessage.CreateAckMessage
methods.description: Static method to create an AckMessage from a ServerMessage and server name.
